purpose: Additive passive recipes for correlating natural pit-state transitions with physical tyre/compound and damage-part fields. Labels retain canonical names or state their limitation.

PitStatus.description: Canonical SDK PitStatus output; observe only.

PitStopEndTime.description: Canonical SDK latched PitStopEndTime field; observe only.

PitTargetFuel.description: Pit-machine field at +0x3484; its target-fuel interpretation remains static until correlated.

FuelLevelDerived.description: FuelLevel at canonical SDK offset; retain DERIVED tier.

PitTyreChangeFlag.description: Pit-machine candidate flag at +0x3490; its human-readable job label is unpromoted.

PitWingChangeFlag.description: Pit-machine candidate flag at +0x3494; its human-readable job label is unpromoted.

PitRepairFlag.description: Pit-machine candidate flag at +0x3498; its human-readable job label is unpromoted.

tireChoice.description: Canonical confirmed int32 compound-list index. It is track-local, not a global compound enum.

nextChosenTires__rw_.description: Canonical SDK field name retained verbatim.

tirePuncture_RR.description: Canonical field name retained; prior evidence supports remaining-tread interpretation, but this trace records values only.

tirePuncture_RL.description: Canonical field name retained; prior evidence supports remaining-tread interpretation, but this trace records values only.

tirePuncture_FR.description: Canonical field name retained; prior evidence supports remaining-tread interpretation, but this trace records values only.

tirePuncture_FL.description: Canonical field name retained; prior evidence supports remaining-tread interpretation, but this trace records values only.

FrontWingIntactFlag.description: Canonical confirmed front-wing intact flag; observe only.

RearWingIntactFlag.description: Canonical rear-wing flag; observe only and never use as an input.

carConditions.description: Canonical damage-severity field; observe only, without assigning part-level cause.

PitVisitCounterCandidate.description: Candidate per-session pit-visit counter from prior full-struct trace; observe only.
